summary: Phase 2B Cycle 3 (FINAL) — Frontend-only e2e test of the Super Admin MARTbakēd Supplier Product Requests review UI at /admin/modules/mart/suppliers?tab=product-requests. Seeded a pending request via /api/supplier/me/product-requests as demo-delta-supplier, then logged in as Super Admin (depexopenai@gmail.com) and validated every acceptance-criteria point from the review request. All 8 spec bullets passed. No blocking issues found.

issues: Tab labels ('Applications' / 'Product Requests') render with sub-note (· 'Onboarding review' / · 'New SKU proposals') at ~10px opacity 0.7 — legible but very small on standard laptop screens. Non-blocking, aesthetic-only.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminSupplierProductRequests.jsx: `mrp` default is `proposed_cost_price * 1.6` — reasonable heuristic but has no visible tooltip explaining it. Admins might submit unrealistic MRPs unknowingly. Consider a hint/tooltip 'auto-suggested at 1.6× supplier cost'.

AdminSupplierProductRequests.jsx line 103: `data.master_product_id.slice(0,12)` will crash if the approve response omits master_product_id (e.g. backend behavioural change). Add optional-chaining fallback (`data?.master_product_id?.slice(0,12) ?? '—'`).

AdminSupplierProductRequests.jsx: the category-load useEffect silently swallows errors (`catch (e) { /* silent */ }`). If /mart/categories fails, admin sees an empty dropdown with no explanation, then submits, then sees 'Category is required'. Prefer a subtle toast or an inline 'Failed to load categories — retry' hint.
AdminSupplierProductRequests.jsx: the drawer overlay uses onClick target-check to close; there is no ESC key handler. Add `keydown Escape` for accessibility parity with the applications drawer.

AdminSupplierProductRequests.jsx: `link_at_supplier_cost` checkbox is checked-by-default; if the supplier proposed no cost, the label reads 'no cost set' but the checkbox stays checked — the backend likely creates a link at cost=null/0. Confirm expected behaviour, or auto-disable + uncheck the box when proposed_cost_price is falsy.

success_rate.backend: n/a (skipped per request; 12/12 pytest previously confirmed)
